description: This PHP class `HTMLPurifier_Injector_PurifierLinkify` extends the HTMLPurifier Injector system to transform placeholder syntax like `%Namespace.Directive` within text tokens into clickable links with URLs derived from configuration. It specifically modifies tokens containing '%'-style directives to generate anchor `<a>` tags with dynamically constructed `href` attributes.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Injector_PurifierLinkify
classes.description: Injector class for converting placeholder directives #%Namespace.Directive within text tokens into clickable links by replacing them with anchor tags linked to URLs defined by configuration.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the injector by fetching the DocURL from configuration and calling the parent prepare method.

methods.name: handleText
methods.description: Processes text tokens to identify placeholder directives and replaces them with anchor tags linking to the generated URLs.
